evidence_snippets: For example, the following schema will receive the request with the image encoded into a field calling image bytes : properties : image bytes : type : string Your custom model receives prediction input in the following format: { "instances" : [ { "image bytes" : { "b64" : " BASE64 ENCODED IMAGE BYTES " } } ] } Before importing the model to Vertex AI Vision, verify that your model works correctly with this input.

Attach application metadata In addition to image bytes, you have the option to set attach application metadata to ask the Vertex AI Vision app platform to include the metadata of the application to be sent along to the custom container.
